goal.title: Establish the Crystal Enhancement Proposal (CEP) Process & Media Asset Extension Standard
goal.intent: Design and formalize an open RFC/JSR-like enhancement framework (Crystal Enhancement Proposals / CEP) for Context Crystal to govern community proposals, core feature evolution, and official domain extensions without scope creep. Deliver CEP-0001 (The CEP Process Specification & Template) and CEP-0002 (Media & Multi-Modal Asset Provenance Extension) as the inaugural reference implementation inspired by autonomous video production and physical studio pipelines.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Draft CEP-0001: Crystal Enhancement Proposal (CEP) Process, Governance & Lifecycle Specification
Create the standardized CEP Document Template (docs/cep/template.md) with architectural invariant guardrails
Draft CEP-0002: Media & Multi-Modal Asset Provenance Extension (video cuts, inspection frames, and review server integration)
Specify the Extension Architecture & Namespace Registry (custom artifact schemas without core bloat)
Establish Cross-Workspace Case Study Linkage: connect CEP-0002 directly to the automated video production pipeline DAG

nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'crystal-enhancement-proposal-process-and-media-extension' with goal: Establish the Crystal Enhancement Proposal (CEP) Process & Media Asset Extension Standard

Formalized the Crystal Enhancement Proposal (CEP) RFC/JSR-like framework (CEP-0001) with human authorship mandate (name + email for accountability) and optional AI co-pilot disclosure. Delivered CEP-0002 (Media & Multi-Modal Asset Provenance Extension) establishing standardized metadata schemas for video cuts, inspection frames, and review servers, anchored in the automated video pipeline case study.

Reviewed CEP process and content: confirmed CEP as Context Crystal's public RFC specification feeding directly into Google Conductor execution (eliminating redundant ADR layers). Updated CEP-0001 with Conductor integration tenets and refined CEP-0002 with origin-agnostic review paths and SHA-256 integrity checksums.

Successfully established the Crystal Enhancement Proposal (CEP) RFC framework (CEP-0001) paired directly with Google Conductor execution, eliminating unnecessary ADR layers. Delivered CEP-0002 for Media & Multi-Modal Asset Provenance with origin-agnostic streaming and SHA-256 integrity verification, anchored in the automated video production DAG.
